tb-403-1.question:
In the circuit below (Fig a), when switch S is opened, the resistance between X and Y is 2 Ω.

Which of the following is/are correct?

(1) R = 3 Ω

(2) When switch S is closed, the resistance between X and Y is reduced.

(3) When switch S is closed, the ammeter records a non-zero reading.

A (1) only

B (3) only

C (1) and (3) only

D (1), (2) and (3)
tb-403-1.reasoning:
When switch S is open,

Req =R1R2R1+R2

2 =(1 + 2)(3 + R)(1 + 2) + (3 + R)

12 + 2R = 9 + 3R

R = 3 Ω

∴ (1) is correct.

When switch S is closed,

Req =1×31+3+2×32+3= 1.95 Ω < 3 Ω

∴ (2) is correct.

When switch S is open,

VXP : VYP = RXP : RYP = 1 : 2

VXQ : VYQ = RXQ : RYQ = 1 : 1

Therefore, there is a p.d. across PQ. A current will flow through the ammeter when switch S is closed.

∴ (3) is correct.

tb-403-7.question:
In the circuit below (Fig g), XY is a uniform wire of resistance 20 Ω. Contact point S can slide along XY. The resistance of bulb Q is 1 Ω. The e.m.f. of the battery is 6 V.

Which of the following statements are correct?

(1) Bulb Q is the dimmest when S is at the midpoint of XY.

(2) The current drawn from the battery is 1 A when S is at the midpoint of XY.

(3) The adjustable range of p.d. across Q is 1−6 V.

A (1) and (2) only

B (1) and (3) only

C (2) and (3) only

D (1), (2) and (3)
tb-403-7.reasoning:
Let r be the resistance of section XS.

Resistance of section SY

= 20 – r

Equivalent resistance Req of the circuit

=1+r×(20−r)r+(20−r)=1 + 100 − (r − 10)220

Req is maximum when r = 10.

Since wire XY is uniform,

XS : SY = r : (20 – r)

= 10 : (20 – 10)

= 1 : 1

i.e. Req is maximum and bulb Q is the dimmest when S is at the midpoint of XY.

∴ (1) is correct.

When S is at the midpoint of XY,

Req =1 + 100 − (10 − 10)220= 6 Ω

By I =VR,

Current drawn from battery

=66

= 1 A

∴ (2) is correct.

P.d. across Q is minimum when Req is maximum.

i.e. when S is at the midpoint of XY.

Apply V = IR.

Minimum p.d. across Q = (1)(1) = 1 V

When S is at point X or Y, wire XY is shorted. P.d. across Q is maximum.

Maximum p.d. across Q = 6 V

∴ (3) is correct.

tb-403-8.question:
Four identical bulbs P, Q, R and S are connected to an ideal battery (Fig h).

The power consumed by bulb Q is 1 W. Which of the following statements is/are correct?

(1) The power consumed by bulb P is 2.25 W.

(2) The power consumed by bulb R is 0.5 W.

(3) If bulb S is shorted, bulb Q will become dimmer.

A (1) only

B (2) only

C (1) and (3) only

D (2) and (3) only
tb-403-8.reasoning:
Let r be the resistance of each bulb.

Apply I =VR.

Consider bulb Q.

IQ =VQr

Consider bulb R.

IR =VQ2r=IQ2

By P = I 2R, P ∝ I 2.

PR = PQ(IRIQ)2= (1)(12)2= 0.25 W

∴ (2) is incorrect.

IP = IQ + IR = IQ +IQ2=32IQ

PP = PQ(IPIQ)2= (1)(32)2= 2.25 W

∴ (1) is correct.

Bulb S shorted

⇒ equivalent resistance of the circuit decreases

⇒ IP increases

⇒ VP increases

⇒ VQ decreases

⇒ bulb Q becomes dimmer

∴ (3) is correct.
